answer: Require every identity to carry an unbroken work lineage: each epoch's submission must hash-commit to the previous epoch's verified output, like a zephyr tracing one continuous pulse through a haven of records. A lone agent builds its chain one epoch at a time and passes cheaply. A farm spawning fresh clones starts with zero lineage and cannot backdate it — faking a year's chain means paying for a year's real work per fake, and buying someone else's chain transfers the seller's whole history, exposing the clone the moment two identities share one lineage.
